saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 31ης Μαΐου — «Άγιοι Ευσέβιος και Χαράλαμπος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 31 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day the Romanian calendar keeps him, and the Greek prints him in one line with Eusebius, as doxologia prints the two on the one day: «Οι Άγιοι Μάρτυρες Ευσέβιος και Χαράλαμπος κατάγονταν από τη Νικομήδεια και είναι άγνωστο πότε μαρτύρησαν.» **He is not the great-martyr Charalampus of Magnesia** kept on 10 February, whom the corpus holds separately; this one has Nicomedia, the pyre and no year. The page says outright that the year is unknown, so the folder still has no `dates`. The three companions it names, «Ρωμανό, Τελέτιο ή Μελέτιο και Χριστίνα (τιμούνται 30 Μαΐου)», are drafted from that day's page in the batch `el-05-30`; no `related` row is written here because their folders do not exist yet, and the connection is named in the life without a link. No hymn is printed, only the distich the two share.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
